'''Rakhuuun''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located in the [[Rakhuuun system/Legends|Rakhuuun system]] of the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]]. It was a part of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]], in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Randon Run/Legends|Randon Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected the planet to the worlds of [[Chamble/Legends|Chamble]] and [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="TEA" />

Rakhuuun was colonized by members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from nearby Kashyyyk, and was known for a small [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] in which [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and [[Yacht/Legends|yachts]] of aesthetically pleasing design were manufactured.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rakhuuun was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]. Although the Rakhuuun [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet Rakhuuun, was placed within grid square P-9 by a map in ''The Essential Atlas'', the book's Appendix section listed it as being located in square Q-10,<ref name="TEA" /> which was repeated in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book.<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> This article assumes the visual map placement is erroneous and that Q-10 is the correct square.
